step1.title: Arrival & VIP Transfer and Hotel Accommodation
step1.text: Your transformation begins the moment you land at the airport! If you're coming from abroad, our special VIP transfer will pick you up and take you safely and comfortably to your hotel or clinic.

step2.title: Personalized Examination and Preparation
step2.text: Before the procedure, we conduct a one-on-one examination with our experts to listen to your expectations. We perform the necessary tests and create the most suitable treatment plan for you.

step3.title: Post-Procedure Care and Recovery
step3.text: After the procedure is completed, we are with you during your recovery process. Depending on your treatment, you can spend time in our comfortable rest rooms or return to your hotel and receive detailed care instructions.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your health and beauty are our priority.
about.description1: As Prince Medical, we were established to provide Turkey's world-class healthcare services to international patients in a safe, transparent, and comfortable manner. By collaborating with expert doctors and fully equipped healthcare institutions, we offer our patients treatment processes at the highest quality standards.
about.description2: With our experience in medical tourism; we develop personalized solutions in aesthetic surgery, hair transplantation, dental treatments, and many other branches. At every stage of the treatment process, we prioritize our patients' needs; providing end-to-end services from consultation to post-treatment.
about.description3: We make the treatment process stress-free and safe by offering travel planning, accommodation, VIP transfer, and multilingual patient coordination services for our guests coming from abroad.
about.description4: As Prince Medical, our fundamental principle is to produce ethical, patient satisfaction-oriented, and sustainable healthcare solutions. Your health is not a service for us, but a responsibility.
